definitions.gloss: rest area; rest stop; rest station
definitions.explanation: A designated place for resting, commonly found along highways, in parks, or at tourist spots.

examples.japanese: {高速道路|こうそくどうろ}の{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}で{休|やす}んだ。
examples.english: I rested at a rest area on the highway.

examples.japanese: {登山|とざん}コースに{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}がある。
examples.english: There's a rest area on the hiking trail.

examples.japanese: {休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}で{飲|の}み{物|もの}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a drink at the rest area.

notes:
FORMATION:
{休憩|きゅうけい} (rest/break) + {所|じょ} (place)

TYPES:
・{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}の{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ} - highway rest area
  - SA (サービスエリア) - service area (larger, more facilities)
  - PA (パーキングエリア) - parking area (smaller)
・{観光地|かんこうち}の{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ} - tourist spot rest area
・{登山|とざん}{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ} - mountain hiking rest station

COLLOCATIONS:
・{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}で{休|やす}む - to rest at a rest area
・{休憩所|きゅうけいじょ}に{寄|よ}る - to stop by a rest area

SIMILAR TERMS:
・{休憩室|きゅうけいしつ} - break room (indoors, in offices)
・{道|みち}の{駅|えき} - roadside station (on regular roads)
